name: JustForPixel ExpressiveLab M3
summary: Open-source Jetpack Compose library of Material 3 Expressive UI and spring-animated motion components for Android.
description: A Kotlin library for Jetpack Compose: elastic push buttons, morphing icon buttons, a centered floating pill navigation bar, wavy and arc sliders, shape-morph loading indicators, an audio equalizer icon and a bouncy squircle card. Installed via JitPack (minSdk 24+); ships an OLED pitch-black theme and Material You dynamic color.
contains: 7 Material 3 Expressive components for Jetpack Compose
spring animations: elastic push, morphing icon button, wavy and arc sliders, shape-morph loader
centered floating pill navigation bar with active label expansion
OLED pitch-black theme and Material You dynamic color
